name: The Shattered Halo
core_rationale: Born from scar-vesper-crater where Vesper the Dream-Eater's tear inverted gravity during the Clockspring War, reserving a high-level (Level 30+) vertical sky-archipelago without needing districts or towns authored today.

parent_world_history_causes.causal_summary: Vesper's slumbering gravity field holds broken ocean chunks suspended in a ring above the northern whirlpool.

mystery_hook.in_world_rumor: Airship captains refuse to fly past the Violet Squall; they claim waterfalls pour upward into the stars and lost toys float back down.
mystery_hook.visual_silhouette: A crescent halo of floating dark-stone islands and inverted waterfalls glowing softly on the northern horizon.
mystery_hook.unanswered_question: What civilization survived on the underside of the floating islands, and how do 1.05 meter Sprouts traverse inverted gravity?
mystery_hook.discovery_trigger_hint: Will transition to draft once Continent 02 Clockwork Steppe is canonized and the Astrolabe Gate is calibrated.

causal_continuity.evidence: Traces directly to god-vesper-dream-eater and scar-vesper-crater in world-history-cradle-of-embers.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Inverted waterfalls pouring upward into a crescent halo of floating basalt islands.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: Intentional mystery: inverted-gravity tether-bridge metrics for 1.05m characters will be specified upon transition to draft.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: Intentional mystery: no districts or hunting areas authored yet; sealed behind locked_by_mystery airship and rift links.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Provides complete in_world_rumor, visual_silhouette, and unanswered_question with zero low-quality filler maps.
